title: [Bug]: _json_loads_with_repair causes system hang in complex tasks
body: **Describe the bug** The `_json_loads_with_repair` method causes the system to crash when processing complex JSON strings that contain special characters such as “” or newlines (`\n`), especially when these strings appear as parameter values in LLM-generated tool calls. This commonly occurs when using a "write file" tool where the `file_content` parameter contains multi-line YAML or JSON content. The method fails to robustly parse or repair such inputs, leading to unhandled exceptions or infinite repair loops, ultimately crashing the agent system. **To Reproduce** My program is a data modeling agent that frequently invokes a file-writing tool to save generated model definitions to local files. The content being written is typically structured data in either YAML or JSON format, which often includes multi-line strings, indentation, and special characters (e.g., newlines, quotes). Under these conditions, the system occasionally crashes, and the issue appears to be tightly linked to the _json_loads_with_repair function—since the crashes cease entirely when I disable or bypass this function. While I haven’t yet constructed a minimal reproducible example, the correlation in my real-world workflow is consistent and significant. I currently do not have a stable way to reproduce this bug in isolation, but in my actual application, the system crash is very pronounced and consistently occurs under complex tool-calling scenarios. Notably, after I commented out the call to _json_loads_with_repair, the crashes have completely disappeared, strongly suggesting that this function is the root cause of the instability. 2. **How to execute** 3. **See error** Each time the system crashes, the following stack trace is captured in the core dump or logs: **Expected behavior** The _json_loads_with_repair method should not be applied unconditionally during intermediate LLM streaming outputs. Instead, the system should treat tool-call parameters as raw text until the LLM finishes generation (i.e., when last=True). Only at that point—when the full response is available—should an attempt be made to parse or repair the JSON structure. This avoids premature and fragile parsing of incomplete or partially streamed content (e.g., truncated YAML/JSON with newlines or unescaped characters), which can trigger unrecoverable errors or hangs in _json_loads_with_repair. **Environment** - AgentScope Version: [e.g., 1.0.10] - Python Version: [e.g., 3.11] - OS: [e.g., CentOS 7.9]
